guide.summary: Chinese sets the scene before the action: who, then when, where, with whom and how, and only then the verb and its object. Almost everything English puts after the verb (tomorrow, at home, with friends, by subway, also, already) goes before it in Chinese, and question words simply sit where the answer would sit.

subs.label: Time, then place, before the verb
subs.focus: Force time-when (明天, 每天早上) and 在 + place before the verb, time ahead of place. Classic mistake: English order with them at the end (我吃饭在家, 我去北京明天). Time may also precede the subject, so order items need that alt. Avoid durations (两个小时) and 住在 / 放在 / 坐在, which follow the verb.

subs.label: 跟…一起 and 一起
subs.focus: The learner must put 跟 / 和 + person + 一起 before the verb, and 一起 directly before the verb phrase after a plural subject. Classic mistakes: 我吃饭跟朋友一起, 我们去一起, 我一起跟他去. Keep 跟…一起 as one tile, or avoid a 在 + place phrase in the same sentence, because the order of the companion and the place is free.

subs.label: How you do it comes first
subs.focus: The learner must put the means or manner (坐地铁, 骑自行车, 用筷子, 用中文, 慢慢地) before the main verb. Classic mistake: English order with the means at the end (我去上班坐地铁, 他吃饭用筷子). Do not mix in 得 complements (跑得很快), which follow the verb and belong to another topic.

subs.label: Adverbs sit after the subject
subs.focus: The learner must place 也 都 还 就 才 常常 已经 一直 after the subject (and after a time word) and before the verb, adjective, modal verb or 在 + place phrase. Classic mistakes: adverb before the subject (也我喜欢, 都我们去) or at the end as in English 'too' (我喜欢茶也). For 就 / 才 the time word comes first: 他八点就来了, 他十点才来.

subs.label: 也 before 都 before 不
subs.focus: The learner must order stacked adverbs: 也 first, then 都, then 不 / 没, then the verb. Classic mistakes: 都也, 不也, and 不都 used where the meaning is 'none of us' (都不). Items contrasting 都不 and 不都 must have an English cue that forces one meaning (none vs not all).

subs.label: Everything describing a noun goes before it
subs.focus: Force every modifier, even a whole clause, before the noun with 的 (我昨天买的书, 穿红衣服的人). Classic mistake: English relative-clause order, clause after the noun (书我昨天买的). Fix 这 / 那 + measure inside a tile: 那个穿红衣服的人 and 穿红衣服的那个人 are both correct.

subs.label: Question words stay in place
subs.focus: The learner must leave 什么 谁 哪儿 什么时候 怎么 几 多少 in the slot where the answer would go, with no fronting and no 吗. Classic mistakes: 什么你想吃, 哪儿你住, 你吃什么吗. 什么时候 and 怎么 go in the time or manner slot before the verb; 为什么 may go before or after the subject, so avoid it in order items or give the alt.

subs.label: Topic first, then the comment
subs.focus: Build and accept sentences with a known, definite object fronted as topic (这本书我看过), adverbs still after the subject (这本书我也看过). Classic mistakes: rejecting a correct topic sentence, or 这本书也我看过. Order items need the plain Subject-Verb-Object order as an alt unless tiles or task exclude it.

subs.label: 先…再
subs.focus: The learner must put 先 and 再 after the subject and directly before each verb phrase: Subject + 先 + first action, 再 + second action. Classic mistakes: 先 before the subject (先我吃饭), 再 after its verb or at the end, and the two actions in the wrong order. 然后 may be added before 再.

rules.rule: A word saying when something happens goes right after the subject (or right before it), never after the verb.

examples.py: wǒ míng tiān qù běi jīng
examples.en: I'm going to Beijing tomorrow.

examples.py: míng tiān wǒ qù běi jīng
examples.en: Tomorrow I'm going to Beijing.

examples.py: tā měi tiān zǎo shang liù diǎn qǐ chuáng
examples.en: He gets up at six every morning.

rules.note: This is about when, not how long. A duration (两个小时, 三年) follows the verb: 我学了三年。 Larger time units come before smaller ones: 每天早上六点.

rules.rule: Where the action happens is said with 在 + place before the verb, and it comes after the time word.
rules.pattern: Subject + time + 在 + place + Verb + Object

examples.py: wǒ zài jiā chī fàn
examples.en: I eat at home.

examples.py: tā zài shàng hǎi gōng zuò
examples.en: She works in Shanghai.

examples.py: wǒ men wǎn shang zài jiā kàn diàn shì
examples.en: We watch television at home in the evening.

rules.note: A few verbs of position take 在 + place after them, because the place is where the person or thing ends up: 他住在北京, 请坐在这儿, 书放在桌子上. A destination is the object of 去 / 来 / 到 and follows it: 我去学校.

rules.rule: The person you do something with comes before the verb, in the frame 跟 … 一起. After a plural subject, 一起 goes directly before the verb phrase.
rules.pattern: Subject + 跟 + person + 一起 + Verb + Object

examples.py: wǒ gēn péng you yī qǐ chī fàn
examples.en: I eat with friends.

examples.py: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ yī qǐ qù
examples.en: I want to go with you.

examples.py: wǒ men yī qǐ qù ba
examples.en: Let's go together.

examples.zh: 昨天我和同学一起看了电影。
examples.py: zuó tiān wǒ hé tóng xué yī qǐ kàn le diàn yǐng
examples.en: Yesterday I watched a film with my classmates.

rules.note: 和 works the same as 跟 here. Modal verbs (想, 要, 能) and 不 go before 跟, not before the main verb: 我不想跟他一起去. When there is also a 在 + place phrase, either order is fine: 我跟朋友在饭馆吃饭 or 我在饭馆跟朋友吃饭.

rules.rule: How you do something (the transport, the tool, the language, the manner) is said before the main verb.
rules.pattern: Subject + 坐 / 骑 / 用 + means + Verb + Object

examples.py: wǒ zuò dì tiě qù shàng bān
examples.en: I go to work by subway.

examples.py: tā yòng kuài zi chī fàn
examples.en: He eats with chopsticks.

examples.zh: 她每天骑自行车去学校。
examples.py: tā měi tiān qí zì xíng chē qù xué xiào
examples.en: She cycles to school every day.

examples.py: qǐng nǐ màn màn de shuō
examples.en: Please speak slowly.

rules.note: Think of it as the order things happen: you get on the subway first, then you arrive at work. A description of how well or how fast an action is done can also follow the verb with 得 (他说得很慢); that is a separate pattern.

rules.rule: 也 都 还 就 才 常常 已经 一直 go after the subject and before the verb or adjective. They never start the sentence and never end it.

examples.py: wǒ yě xǐ huan hē chá
examples.en: I like drinking tea too.

examples.py: tā yǐ jīng huí jiā le
examples.en: He has already gone home.

examples.py: wǒ men cháng cháng zài nà r chī fàn
examples.en: We often eat there.

examples.py: wǒ míng tiān yě xiǎng qù
examples.en: I want to go tomorrow too.

rules.note: The adverb goes before the whole verb phrase, so it comes before a modal verb (也想去), before 在 + place (常常在那儿吃饭) and before 跟 … 一起 (也跟他一起去). It normally comes after a time word.

rules.rule: 就 (earlier than expected) and 才 (later than expected) go after the time word and before the verb.
rules.pattern: Subject + time + 就 / 才 + Verb

examples.py: tā bā diǎn jiù lái le
examples.en: He was here as early as eight.

examples.py: tā shí diǎn cái lái
examples.en: He didn't come until ten.

examples.zh: 我昨天晚上十二点才睡觉。
examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang shí èr diǎn cái shuì jiào
examples.en: I didn't go to bed until twelve last night.

rules.note: A sentence with this 才 normally has no 了 after the verb, while 就 usually has it.

rules.rule: When several of these come together the order is fixed: 也, then 都, then 不 or 没, then the verb.
rules.pattern: Subject + 也 + 都 + 不 / 没 + Verb + Object

examples.py: wǒ men yě dōu bù hē jiǔ
examples.en: None of us drink either.

examples.py: tā men yě dōu shì xué sheng
examples.en: They are all students too.

examples.py: wǒ yě bù zhī dào
examples.en: I don't know either.

examples.py: wǒ men dōu méi qù guo shàng hǎi
examples.en: None of us have been to Shanghai.

rules.note: 也 is always first. 都不 and 不都 are both possible but mean different things: 我们都不是学生 is 'none of us are students', 我们不都是学生 is 'not all of us are students'.

rules.rule: Whatever describes a noun, even a whole clause, goes before the noun and is linked to it with 的. Nothing describing the noun comes after it.

examples.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de shū hěn guì
examples.en: The book I bought yesterday was expensive.

examples.py: zhè shì mā ma zuò de cài
examples.en: This is the food Mum made.

examples.zh: 那个穿红衣服的人是我姐姐。
examples.py: nà ge chuān hóng yī fu de rén shì wǒ jiě jie
examples.en: The person in red is my older sister.

examples.zh: 我买了一本很有意思的书。
examples.py: wǒ mǎi le yī běn hěn yǒu yì si de shū
examples.en: I bought a very interesting book.

rules.note: Number + measure word comes before the description: 一本很有意思的书. With 这 / 那 and a clause both orders are used: 那个穿红衣服的人 or 穿红衣服的那个人.

rules.rule: Do not move the question word. Make the statement, then replace the unknown part with the question word, and do not add 吗.
rules.pattern: Subject + Verb + 什么 / 谁 / 哪儿    Subject + 什么时候 / 怎么 + Verb

examples.py: nǐ xiǎng chī shén me
examples.en: What do you want to eat?

examples.py: nǐ zài nǎ r gōng zuò
examples.en: Where do you work?

examples.py: nǐ shén me shí hou qù běi jīng
examples.en: When are you going to Beijing?

examples.py: nǐ gēn shéi yī qǐ qù
examples.en: Who are you going with?

rules.note: The question word is first only when it is the subject: 谁知道？ 什么时候 can also come before the subject, like any time word, and 为什么 goes either before or after the subject.

rules.rule: A thing both speakers already know about can be put first as the topic; the rest of the sentence then keeps its normal order, with adverbs still after the subject.

examples.py: zhè běn shū wǒ kàn guo
examples.en: This book, I've read.

examples.py: nà ge diàn yǐng wǒ hái méi kàn
examples.en: I haven't seen that film yet.

examples.py: zuò yè wǒ yǐ jīng zuò wán le
examples.en: I've already finished the homework.

examples.py: zhōng guó cài wǒ yě hěn xǐ huan
examples.en: I like Chinese food a lot too.

rules.note: The topic must be definite or general (this book, the homework, Chinese food), not something new like 一本书. The ordinary order (我看过这本书) is also correct; fronting is a choice, common when the object is what the conversation is about or is being contrasted.

rules.rule: For 'first A, then B', 先 and 再 are adverbs: each goes after the subject and directly before its verb phrase.
rules.pattern: Subject + 先 + Verb 1, (然后) + 再 + Verb 2

examples.py: wǒ xiān chī fàn zài zuò zuò yè
examples.en: I'll eat first and then do my homework.

examples.zh: 我们先去银行，再去超市。
examples.py: wǒ men xiān qù yín háng zài qù chāo shì
examples.en: We'll go to the bank first, then to the supermarket.

examples.py: nǐ xiān xǐ shǒu zài chī dōng xi
examples.en: Wash your hands first, then eat.

examples.zh: 你先休息一下，然后我们再走。
examples.py: nǐ xiān xiū xi yī xià rán hòu wǒ men zài zǒu
examples.en: Rest for a bit first, and then we'll leave.

rules.note: If the second clause has its own subject, 再 still follows that subject (我们再走). 然后 is a linking word and may come before the subject.

contrasts.why: The place where the action happens goes before the verb, not at the end as in English.

right.py: wǒ míng tiān qù běi jīng

contrasts.why: A time-when word goes next to the subject, before the verb. It can never close the sentence.

right.py: wǒ gēn péng you yī qǐ chī fàn

contrasts.why: English says 'eat with friends'; Chinese says who you are with first, then what you do: 跟朋友一起 + verb.

right.py: wǒ zuò dì tiě qù shàng bān
right.en: I go to work by subway.

contrasts.why: The means of getting there comes before 去. 'By subway' is a verb phrase (坐地铁) placed ahead of the main verb.

right.py: wǒ yě xǐ huan hē chá

contrasts.why: 也 is an adverb: it follows the subject and comes before the verb. It cannot start the sentence or go at the end like 'too'.

right.py: wǒ men yě dōu bù qù
right.en: None of us are going either.

contrasts.why: Stacked adverbs have a fixed order: 也, then 都, then 不.

right.py: wǒ xǐ huan nǐ mǎi de shū
right.en: I like the book you bought.

contrasts.why: A clause describing a noun goes before the noun with 的. Chinese has no 'the book that you bought' order.

right.en: What do you want to eat?

contrasts.why: The question word stays where the answer would be: 你想吃饺子 becomes 你想吃什么.

right.py: zhè běn shū wǒ yě kàn guo

contrasts.why: Fronting the object as a topic does not move the adverb: 也 still goes after the subject 我.

right.py: wǒ xiān chī fàn zài zuò zuò yè
right.en: I'll eat first and then do my homework.

contrasts.why: 先 is an adverb, not a sentence opener like English 'first': it goes after the subject, right before the verb.

cheat: Who, when, where, with whom, how, then the verb. If it sets the scene, it goes before the verb.
Time-when and 在 + place never end the sentence; time comes before place.
也 都 还 就 才 常常 已经 一直 and 先 / 再: after the subject, before the verb, never first, never last.
Stacking order: 也, 都, 不. 都不 means none, 不都 means not all.
跟 + person + 一起 + verb; by subway or with chopsticks goes before the main verb too.
Describing a noun? Put it all in front and add 的: 我昨天买的书.
Question word: write the answer sentence, swap in the question word, no moving, no 吗.

tokens: 在这家医院工作了十年的
alts: 在这家医院工作了十年的
items.zh: 我想找那位在这家医院工作了十年的医生。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng zhǎo nà wèi zài zhè jiā yī yuàn gōng zuò le shí nián de yī shēng
items.en: I want to find the doctor who has worked at this hospital for ten years.
items.why: The long 'who has worked here ten years' clause goes in front of 医生, on either side of 那位, never after it.

items.zh: 我这个星期一直觉得头疼。
items.py: wǒ zhè ge xīng qī yī zhí jué de tóu téng
items.en: I've had a headache all this week.
items.why: 一直 follows the time word and precedes 觉得. It never sits before 我 or after 头疼.

items.s: 先我给客户打电话，再发邮件。
items.s_py: xiān wǒ gěi kè hù dǎ diàn huà zài fā yóu jiàn
items.zh: 我先给客户打电话，再发邮件。
items.py: wǒ xiān gěi kè hù dǎ diàn huà zài fā yóu jiàn
items.en: I'll call the client first and then send an email.
items.why: 先 is an adverb and goes after the subject, not before it as English 'first' can.

items.s_py: wǒ míng tiān yě xiǎng qù yī yuàn
items.py: wǒ míng tiān yě xiǎng qù yī yuàn
items.en: I want to go to the hospital tomorrow too.
items.why: 也 follows the time word and precedes the modal 想, which is exactly where it belongs.

items.s_py: wǒ men qù yī qǐ kāi huì
items.py: wǒ men yī qǐ qù kāi huì
items.en: We are going to the meeting together.
items.why: 一起 must sit directly before the verb phrase 去开会. After 去 it is wrong.

items.s_py: wǒ qù yī yuàn zuò chū zū chē
items.py: wǒ zuò chū zū chē qù yī yuàn
items.en: I go to the hospital by taxi.
items.why: The means 坐出租车 goes before the main verb 去. Putting it at the end is English order.

items.py: wǒ liù diǎn jiù qǐ chuáng le
items.en: I was up as early as six.
items.why: 就 follows the time word 六点 and precedes the verb. 就六点 would change the meaning.

items.s: 她每天走路去上班，不坐车。
items.s_py: tā měi tiān zǒu lù qù shàng bān bù zuò chē
items.zh: 她每天走路去上班，不坐车。
items.py: tā měi tiān zǒu lù qù shàng bān bù zuò chē
items.en: She walks to work every day and doesn't go by car or bus.
items.why: 走路 is the manner and correctly precedes 去上班, so the sentence is fine despite the look of two verbs in a row.

items.py: tā měi tiān zài yī yuàn gōng zuò
items.en: He works at the hospital every day.
items.why: 每天 and 在医院 both set the scene, so both precede 工作, with the time word first.

items.zh: 我昨天晚上十二点才睡觉。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang shí èr diǎn cái shuì jiào
items.en: I didn't go to bed until twelve last night.
items.why: 才 comes after the time word and before the verb: 'not until twelve'. Placing 才 before the time or at the end fails.

items.py: wǒ míng tiān zài gōng sī kāi huì
items.en: I have a meeting at the office tomorrow.
items.why: Time comes first, then 在 + place, then the verb. Putting 在公司 after 开会 copies English order and is wrong.

items.py: wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de yào hěn yǒu yòng
items.en: The medicine I bought yesterday is very useful.
items.why: A clause before a noun must be linked with 的. Without 的 it would be read as a separate verb phrase.

items.src_py: wǒ chī yào rán hòu shuì jiào
items.task: Say 'first … then …' with 先 and 再.
items.py: wǒ xiān chī yào zài shuì jiào
items.en: I'll take my medicine first and then go to sleep.
items.why: 先 goes after the subject before the first verb, and 再 goes right before the second verb phrase.

items.zh: 她最近常常在公司加班。
items.py: tā zuì jìn cháng cháng zài gōng sī jiā bān
items.en: She has often worked overtime at the office lately.
items.why: Time word, then 常常, then 在公司 and the verb; 常常 normally comes first, though 在公司常常加班 is also said. Neither may follow 加班.

items.zh: 你先休息一下然后我们再去医院。
items.py: nǐ xiān xiū xi yī xià rán hòu wǒ men zài qù yī yuàn
items.en: Rest for a moment first, and then we'll go to the hospital.
items.why: 再 follows its own subject 我们 and precedes 去医院. 先 follows 你.

items.py: wǒ men yě dōu bù chōu yān
items.en: None of us smoke either.
items.why: The fixed stack is 也, 都, 不, verb. 都也不 or 不也都 are wrong.

items.py: zhè xiē yào wǒ dōu chī wán le
items.en: I've taken all of this medicine.
items.why: The topic 这些药 comes first and 都 follows the subject 我 before the verb.

items.s: 医生去北京开会下个星期。
items.s_py: yī shēng qù běi jīng kāi huì xià ge xīng qī
items.zh: 医生下个星期去北京开会。
items.py: yī shēng xià ge xīng qī qù běi jīng kāi huì
items.en: The doctor is going to Beijing for a meeting next week.
items.why: A time-when phrase like 下个星期 belongs before the verb. It can never close the sentence.

items.s_py: tā yī qǐ gēn péng you qù pǎo bù
items.py: tā gēn péng you yī qǐ qù pǎo bù
items.en: He goes running with his friends.
items.why: 跟 + person + 一起 is one frame in that order. 一起 cannot come before 跟.

items.py: nǐ xiān liáng tǐ wēn zài chī yào
items.en: Take your temperature first, then take the medicine.
items.why: The order of actions follows the order of 先 and 再. Swapping them would reverse the medical advice.

items.zh: 经理星期一上午在会议室开会。
items.py: jīng lǐ xīng qī yī shàng wǔ zài huì yì shì kāi huì
items.en: The manager has a meeting in the conference room on Monday morning.
items.why: Time before place before verb. The time phrase may also open the sentence, but 在会议室 can never follow 开会.

items.q: 弟弟昨天晚上两点___睡觉，今天一直很困。
items.zh: 弟弟昨天晚上两点才睡觉，今天一直很困。
items.py: dì di zuó tiān wǎn shang liǎng diǎn cái shuì jiào jīn tiān yī zhí hěn kùn
items.en: My younger brother didn't go to bed until two last night, so he's been sleepy all day.
items.why: 才 after the time word means 'not until', which explains the tiredness. 就 would say he slept as early as two.

items.py: nǐ xiǎng gēn shéi yī qǐ qù yī yuàn
items.en: Who do you want to go to the hospital with?
items.why: 谁 stays in the companion slot inside 跟…一起, before the verb, after 想.

items.py: tā yòng zhōng wén xiě yóu jiàn
items.en: He writes emails in Chinese.
items.why: 用中文 names the tool or language and goes before the main verb 写. After the verb it is wrong.

items.zh: 经理先看报告然后再给客户打电话。
items.py: jīng lǐ xiān kàn bào gào rán hòu zài gěi kè hù dǎ diàn huà
items.en: The manager reads the report first and then calls the client.
items.why: 然后 links the steps, 再 still sits directly before the second verb phrase, and 先 follows the subject.

items.zh: 我想跟经理一起去出差。
items.py: wǒ xiǎng gēn jīng lǐ yī qǐ qù chū chāi
items.en: I want to go on the business trip with the manager.
items.why: The modal 想 comes before 跟经理一起, which in turn comes before 去出差.

items.zh: 我看了经理昨天写的报告。
items.py: wǒ kàn le jīng lǐ zuó tiān xiě de bào gào
items.en: I read the report the manager wrote yesterday.
items.why: The modifier clause 经理昨天写的 stands before 报告, with 的 linking them.

items.py: jīng lǐ yòng diàn nǎo zuò bào gào
items.en: The manager makes the report on a computer.
items.why: 用电脑 is the means and sits before 做报告, not after it.

items.s_py: nǐ kāi huì shén me shí hou
items.py: nǐ shén me shí hou kāi huì
items.en: When is your meeting?
items.why: 什么时候 is a time word, so it goes before the verb like any other time word.

items.src_py: tā men zài huì yì shì kāi huì
items.zh: 他们上个星期五在会议室开会。
items.py: tā men shàng ge xīng qī wǔ zài huì yì shì kāi huì
items.en: They had a meeting in the conference room last Friday.
items.why: The time word goes after the subject and before 在会议室. It cannot be added after 开会.

items.src_py: wǒ men dōu bù hē kā fēi
items.py: wǒ men yě dōu bù hē kā fēi
items.en: None of us drink coffee either.
items.why: 也 goes first in the stack: 也 都 不. Inserting it after 都 or 不 is wrong.

items.py: nà ge huì yì wǒ yě cān jiā le
items.en: I attended that meeting too.
items.why: Topic first, then subject, then 也 before the verb. 也 cannot jump in front of 我.

items.s: 我们不都是医生，有的是护士。
items.s_py: wǒ men bù dōu shì yī shēng yǒu de shì hù shi
items.zh: 我们不都是医生，有的是护士。
items.py: wǒ men bù dōu shì yī shēng yǒu de shì hù shi
items.en: Not all of us are doctors; some are nurses.
items.why: 不都 is correct for 'not all'; 有的是护士 confirms that some of them are not doctors. 都不 would say that none of them is a doctor.

items.s: 这个问题也我想问经理。
items.s_py: zhè ge wèn tí yě wǒ xiǎng wèn jīng lǐ
items.zh: 这个问题我也想问经理。
items.py: zhè ge wèn tí wǒ yě xiǎng wèn jīng lǐ
items.en: I want to ask the manager this question too.
items.why: The topic 这个问题 comes first, but 也 still follows the subject 我 and precedes the modal 想.

items.task: Say you go with your mother (跟妈妈一起).
items.py: wǒ gēn mā ma yī qǐ qù yī yuàn
items.en: I go to the hospital with my mother.
items.why: The companion goes before the verb, after the subject: 跟妈妈一起 + 去医院.

items.s: 穿白衣服的那个医生很年轻。
items.s_py: chuān bái yī fu de nà ge yī shēng hěn nián qīng
items.zh: 穿白衣服的那个医生很年轻。
items.py: chuān bái yī fu de nà ge yī shēng hěn nián qīng
items.en: The doctor in white is very young.
items.why: The description may come before 那个 as well as after it, and in both cases stays before 医生.

items.py: wǒ zuò dì tiě qù shàng bān
items.en: I go to work by subway.
items.why: 坐 + vehicle comes before 去上班 for riding as a passenger. 骑 and 开 are for bikes and driving.

items.zh: 我们部门的人也都不想加班。
items.py: wǒ men bù mén de rén yě dōu bù xiǎng jiā bān
items.en: None of the people in our department want to work overtime either.
items.why: The stack 也 都 不 stays unbroken after the long subject, and 加班 comes last.

items.py: tā yǐ jīng xià bān le
items.en: He has already finished work.
items.why: 已经 sits after the subject, before the verb. It cannot start the sentence or go at the end.

items.s_py: wǒ men dōu yě shì yī shēng
items.py: wǒ men yě dōu shì yī shēng
items.en: We are all doctors too.
items.why: Stacked adverbs go 也 before 都. 都也 is wrong.

items.zh: 那是昨天来开会的客户。
items.py: nà shì zuó tiān lái kāi huì de kè hù
items.en: That is the client who came to the meeting yesterday.
items.why: 昨天来开会的 describes 客户 and must precede it. 客户昨天来开会的 is English order.

items.zh: 你怎么去医院？——我坐地铁去。
items.py: nǐ zěn me qù yī yuàn wǒ zuò dì tiě qù
items.en: How do you get to the hospital? I go by subway.
items.why: 怎么 asks about the means and goes before the verb, in the slot where 坐地铁 would be.

items.zh: 那个穿白衣服的医生是我叔叔。
items.py: nà ge chuān bái yī fu de yī shēng shì wǒ shū shu
items.en: The doctor in white is my uncle.
items.why: The description 穿白衣服的 precedes 医生, either before or after 那个. It cannot follow 医生.

items.py: xiǎo wáng qí zì xíng chē qù gōng sī
items.en: Xiao Wang cycles to the company.
items.why: The means of travel is a verb phrase before 去. 去公司骑自行车 follows English order.

items.py: wǒ yě xiǎng qù yī yuàn nǐ ne
items.en: I want to go to the hospital too. What about you?
items.why: 也 gives 'too' and sits before 想. 都 needs a group subject and 还 would mean 'still'.

items.zh: 我昨天晚上在医院照顾奶奶。
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang zài yī yuàn zhào gù nǎi nai
items.en: I looked after my grandmother at the hospital last night.
items.why: The place of the action, 在医院, goes before 照顾 and after the time word. Ending with 在医院 is the English habit.

items.py: wǒ xiǎng gēn nǐ yī qǐ qù yī yuàn
items.en: I want to go to the hospital with you.
items.why: 跟你一起 is the frame for 'with you' and goes before the verb 去. The other options do not mean 'together'.

items.s: 小王昨天晚上十二点才下班，今天八点就到公司了。
items.s_py: xiǎo wáng zuó tiān wǎn shang shí èr diǎn cái xià bān jīn tiān bā diǎn jiù dào gōng sī le
items.zh: 小王昨天晚上十二点才下班，今天八点就到公司了。
items.py: xiǎo wáng zuó tiān wǎn shang shí èr diǎn cái xià bān jīn tiān bā diǎn jiù dào gōng sī le
items.en: Xiao Wang didn't finish work until midnight last night, yet he was at the company by eight today.
items.why: Both 才 and 就 follow their time word and precede the verb, so the sentence is right.

items.py: nǐ xiān xǐ shǒu zài chī fàn
items.en: Wash your hands first, then eat.
items.why: 先 and 再 each sit after the subject and right before their verb: 先洗手, 再吃饭. 先你 is wrong.

items.zh: 医生说你先吃饭，再吃药。
items.py: yī shēng shuō nǐ xiān chī fàn zài chī yào
items.en: The doctor says to eat first and then take the medicine.
items.why: 先 pairs with 再 for 'first A, then B'. 又 is for repeated past actions and 也 means 'too'.

items.q: 他___筷子吃米饭，不用叉子。
items.zh: 他用筷子吃米饭，不用叉子。
items.py: tā yòng kuài zi chī mǐ fàn bù yòng chā zi
items.en: He eats rice with chopsticks, not with a fork.
items.why: 用 + tool goes before the main verb 吃. 跟 introduces a companion, not a tool.

items.zh: 经理一直在会议室等客户。
items.py: jīng lǐ yī zhí zài huì yì shì děng kè hù
items.en: The manager has been waiting for the client in the conference room all along.
items.why: 一直 goes before the verb 等, either before or after 在会议室, but never after 等 or before 经理.

items.s: 我收到了邮件经理发的。
items.s_py: wǒ shōu dào le yóu jiàn jīng lǐ fā de
items.zh: 我收到了经理发的邮件。
items.py: wǒ shōu dào le jīng lǐ fā de yóu jiàn
items.en: I received the email the manager sent.
items.why: 经理发的 describes 邮件 and must come before it, not after.

items.py: zhè ge yào wǒ chī guo
items.en: I've taken this medicine.
items.why: A known object can be fronted as the topic, leaving 我 吃过. The plain 我吃过这个药 is equally correct.

items.py: nǐ men zài nǎ r kāi huì
items.en: Where are you having the meeting?
items.why: 在哪儿 takes the slot of 在 + place, before the verb. 你们开会在哪儿 is English-style.

items.task: Say she goes by taxi (出租车).
items.py: nǎi nai zuò chū zū chē qù yī yuàn
items.en: Grandma goes to the hospital by taxi.
items.why: 坐出租车 is the means and goes before the main verb 去.

items.task: Ask what he wants to drink.
items.py: tā xiǎng hē shén me
items.en: What does he want to drink?
items.why: Replace 水 with 什么 in the same slot. Do not move it to the front or add 吗.

items.s: 昨天我在公司跟同事一起开了会。
items.s_py: zuó tiān wǒ zài gōng sī gēn tóng shì yī qǐ kāi le huì
items.zh: 昨天我在公司跟同事一起开了会。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ zài gōng sī gēn tóng shì yī qǐ kāi le huì
items.en: Yesterday I held a meeting with colleagues at the company.
items.why: Place and companion both precede the verb, and either order is fine. Nothing here follows 开了会 that should come before it.

items.zh: 经理的邮件我还没回复。
items.py: jīng lǐ de yóu jiàn wǒ hái méi huí fù
items.en: I haven't replied to the manager's email yet.
items.why: The fronted topic leaves 还没 right before the verb, after 我. 还 cannot precede 我.

items.py: wǒ tóu téng wǒ tóng shì yě tóu téng
items.en: I have a headache, and my colleague has one too.
items.why: 也 means 'too' and sits before the verb phrase. 都 needs a plural group, and 还 would mean 'still'.

items.py: nǐ xiǎng chī shén me
items.en: What do you want to eat?
items.why: 什么 stays where the answer (the food) would be, after 吃. Fronting it as 什么你想吃 is wrong.

items.zh: 你觉得哪家医院的医生最好？
items.py: nǐ jué de nǎ jiā yī yuàn de yī shēng zuì hǎo
items.en: Which hospital's doctors do you think are best?
items.why: 哪家医院的 stays inside the noun phrase as a modifier before 医生; the question word is not moved to the front.

items.s_py: wǒ chī wǔ fàn zài gōng sī
items.py: wǒ zài gōng sī chī wǔ fàn
items.en: I have lunch at the office.
items.why: Where the action happens goes before the verb: 在公司吃午饭. Ending with 在公司 is English order.

items.zh: 他常常用手机回复客户的邮件。
items.py: tā cháng cháng yòng shǒu jī huí fù kè hù de yóu jiàn
items.en: He often replies to clients' emails on his phone.
items.why: Adverb 常常 first after the subject, then the means 用手机, then the verb. 用手机 cannot follow the object.

items.s_py: zhè fèn wén jiàn yě wǒ kàn guo
items.py: zhè fèn wén jiàn wǒ yě kàn guo
items.en: I've read this document too.
items.why: Even after fronting the topic, 也 still goes after the subject 我, not before it.

items.py: nǐ shén me shí hou qù kàn yī shēng
items.en: When are you going to see the doctor?
items.why: 什么时候 is a time word, so it sits where time words do, before the verb. It cannot end the sentence.

items.zh: 医生让我慢慢地站起来。
items.py: yī shēng ràng wǒ màn màn de zhàn qǐ lái
items.en: The doctor told me to stand up slowly.
items.why: 慢慢地 describes how the action is done and goes just before 站起来, after 我. It cannot be tacked on at the end.

items.zh: 护士每天晚上十点在病房里检查病人的情况。
items.py: hù shi měi tiān wǎn shang shí diǎn zài bìng fáng lǐ jiǎn chá bìng rén de qíng kuàng
items.en: The nurse checks on the patients in the ward at ten every night.
items.why: Time, then place, then verb and object. 在病房里 cannot trail after the object.

items.s_py: wǒ chī le yào yī shēng gěi wǒ de
items.py: wǒ chī le yī shēng gěi wǒ de yào
items.en: I took the medicine the doctor gave me.
items.why: The clause 医生给我的 describes 药 and must stand before it. After the noun it is not Chinese.

items.s: 谁知道这份报告在哪儿？
items.s_py: shéi zhī dào zhè fèn bào gào zài nǎ r
items.zh: 谁知道这份报告在哪儿？
items.py: shéi zhī dào zhè fèn bào gào zài nǎ r
items.en: Who knows where this report is?
items.why: 谁 comes first here because it is the subject, and 哪儿 stays at the end in place of the location.

items.s_py: zhè zhǒng yào wǒ chī le sān tiān le
items.py: zhè zhǒng yào wǒ chī le sān tiān le
items.en: I've been taking this kind of medicine for three days.
items.why: A known thing as topic is fine, and the duration 三天 correctly follows the verb.

items.s_py: tā zhù zài yī yuàn páng biān
items.py: tā zhù zài yī yuàn páng biān
items.en: He lives next to the hospital.
items.why: 住 is a verb of position, so 在 + place follows it to show where he ends up. The before-the-verb rule is for where an action takes place.

items.py: tóng shì men yě dōu méi chī zǎo fàn
items.en: None of my colleagues had breakfast either.
items.why: 也, then 都, then 没, then the verb. 没都 would mean 'not all'.

items.zh: 我每天坐公共汽车去公司。
items.py: wǒ měi tiān zuò gōng gòng qì chē qù gōng sī
items.en: I take the bus to the office every day.
items.why: Time word first, then the means 坐公共汽车, then 去公司. The means can never come after 去公司.

items.src_py: wǒ yǐ jīng jiāo le bào gào
items.task: Put 报告 first as the topic.
items.py: bào gào wǒ yǐ jīng jiāo le
items.en: I've already handed in the report.
items.why: The known object moves to the front and the rest keeps its order, with 已经 still after 我.

items.s_py: wǒ yě bù xiǎng jiā bān
items.py: wǒ yě bù xiǎng jiā bān
items.en: I don't want to work overtime either.
items.why: 也 comes before 不, and both precede the verb phrase, so this is the normal order.

items.q: 同事们___会说英语，有的会，有的不会。
items.zh: 同事们不都会说英语，有的会，有的不会。
items.py: tóng shì men bù dōu huì shuō yīng yǔ yǒu de huì yǒu de bù huì
items.en: Not all my colleagues speak English; some do and some don't.
items.why: 不都 means 'not all'. 都不 would say none can, which contradicts 有的会. 都也 has the wrong order.

items.src_py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn le zhè fèn bào gào
items.task: Say 'The report I read yesterday was long.'
items.py: wǒ zuó tiān kàn de bào gào hěn cháng
items.en: The report I read yesterday was long.
items.why: The clause 我昨天看 moves in front of 报告 with 的, and 了 drops out.

items.s_py: wǒ men jiā bān cháng cháng
items.py: wǒ men cháng cháng jiā bān
items.en: We often work overtime.
items.why: Frequency adverbs like 常常 go before the verb. They cannot be added at the end.

items.py: zhè shì wǒ zuó tiān mǎi de yào
items.en: This is the medicine I bought yesterday.
items.why: The whole clause 我昨天买的 goes before 药. 药我昨天买的 is relative-clause English order.

items.py: wǒ men yī qǐ qù kàn yī shēng
items.en: We are going to see the doctor together.
items.why: 一起 sits directly before the verb phrase after a plural subject. 我们去一起 is the common error.

items.q: 他___在医院工作，已经十年了。
items.zh: 他一直在医院工作，已经十年了。
items.py: tā yī zhí zài yī yuàn gōng zuò yǐ jīng shí nián le
items.en: He has worked at the hospital all along, for ten years now.
items.why: 一直 means continuously and goes before 在医院工作. 刚 and 才 do not fit 'for ten years'.

items.zh: 今天早上我们都没吃早饭。
items.py: jīn tiān zǎo shang wǒ men dōu méi chī zǎo fàn
items.en: None of us had breakfast this morning.
items.why: 都 comes before the negative 没, giving 'none of us did'. 没都 and 不都 mean 'not all'.

items.zh: 周末我跟爸爸一起去医院检查身体。
items.py: zhōu mò wǒ gēn bà ba yī qǐ qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá shēn tǐ
items.en: At the weekend I'm going to the hospital with my dad for a check-up.
items.why: Companion phrase before the verbs, time word at the front or after 我. Putting 跟爸爸一起 at the end is the English order.

items.zh: 我上个月在北京的分公司开了一次会。
items.py: wǒ shàng ge yuè zài běi jīng de fēn gōng sī kāi le yī cì huì
items.en: Last month I had a meeting at the Beijing branch office.
items.why: The long place phrase is still just 在 + place before the verb, and 上个月 stays ahead of it or ahead of the subject.

items.q: 他们___都不想去开会，你们呢？
items.zh: 他们也都不想去开会，你们呢？
items.py: tā men yě dōu bù xiǎng qù kāi huì nǐ men ne
items.en: None of them want to go to the meeting either. What about you?
items.why: 'Either' is 也, which goes before 都 and 不. 才 and 又 do not mean 'also' here.

items.py: wǒ gēn tóng shì yī qǐ chī wǔ fàn
items.en: I have lunch with my colleagues.
items.why: The companion goes before the verb in 跟…一起. 吃午饭跟同事一起 is English order.

items.src_py: tā míng tiān xiǎng qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá
items.task: Say she wants to go too (也).
items.zh: 她明天也想去医院检查。
items.py: tā míng tiān yě xiǎng qù yī yuàn jiǎn chá
items.en: She wants to go to the hospital for a check-up tomorrow too.
items.why: 也 comes after the time word and before the modal 想. It does not go before 她 or at the end.

items.py: wǒ men xiān kāi huì zài chī wǔ fàn
items.en: We'll have the meeting first and then lunch.
items.why: 先 marks the first action, 再 the second, both directly before their verbs.

items.py: wǒ men cháng cháng yī qǐ jiā bān
items.en: We often work overtime together.
items.why: 常常 goes right after the subject, then 一起 directly before the verb. 一起常常 or 加班一起 fail.

items.src_py: yī shēng dào yī yuàn le
items.task: Say the doctor arrived as early as seven (七点).
items.py: yī shēng qī diǎn jiù dào yī yuàn le
items.en: The doctor was at the hospital as early as seven.
items.why: 七点 then 就 then the verb. 就 marks 'earlier than expected' and goes after the time word.

items.zh: 昨天我和同事一起去了医院。
items.py: zuó tiān wǒ hé tóng shì yī qǐ qù le yī yuàn
items.en: Yesterday I went to the hospital with a colleague.
items.why: 和同事一起 precedes the verb phrase, after the subject. 昨天 can open the sentence or follow 我 but never close it.

items.py: wǒ wǔ diǎn bàn zài mén kǒu děng nǐ
items.en: I'll wait for you at the entrance at half past five.
items.why: 五点半 then 在门口 then 等你. Neither phrase may come after 等你.

items.s_py: yě wǒ xǐ huan yùn dòng
items.py: wǒ yě xǐ huan yùn dòng
items.en: I like sports too.
items.why: 也 is an adverb and must follow the subject. It cannot open the sentence.

items.py: wǒ yě xiǎng xiū xi
items.en: I want to rest too.
items.why: 也 follows the subject and comes before the modal 想. English 'too' at the end does not exist here.

items.zh: 这份报告我已经写完了。
items.py: zhè fèn bào gào wǒ yǐ jīng xiě wán le
items.en: I've already finished writing this report.
items.why: With 这份报告 fronted, 已经 still sits after the subject 我, not before it.
